project.title: Request handling — August vs September performance comparison

sources.title: Verbal summary: August 10 completed, mean 2 days; September 30 completed, mean 4 days, cases more complex

sections.title: September: 30 completed requests, mean 4 days, more complex
Request: prove the new manager worsened performance

decisions.question: Who is the process owner for the request workflow and for the October measurement (complexity tiers, waiting vs active time)?

Supply case-level exports for full August and September (case id, workflow version, created/completed timestamps, action history), the manager's start date and the list of changes the manager introduced. Without them the attribution question stays open.
Agree the complexity tier criteria (simple / standard / complex) to be recorded at intake from October; if this needs a new intake field or action, plan it with provia-workflow-change.
